title: Local Conformal Field Theories from Non-Semisimple Tensor Categories
exact_target: Construct full local conformal theories from nonsemisimple chiral tensor categories, including their bulk objects and consistent correlators.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002839 (OWR-13673-008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Conformal Field Theory (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/16, pp. 849--926. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 32, 33, 34.
Gaberdiel--Kausch, local logarithmic CFT (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Fuchs--Schweigert, non-semisimple correlators (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: Braiding, duality and any nondegeneracy hypotheses needed by a construction must be read from the report. The extraction\textquotesingle s bare finite-tensor-category hypothesis is not silently supplemented to claim a theorem for a narrower class.
